statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-54404 (zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained arrays, sets and maps) is in the zod package before 4.6.6: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5. Its CNA, VulnCheck, rejected the CVE record on 2026-10-28 as expected validator behaviour rather than a defect in zod (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-54404), but the GitHub advisory still lists zod before 4.6.6 as affected and 4.6.6 as patched, so this decision follows that range. Jaeger embeds its prebuilt web UI in /usr/bin/jaeger, the only file in the package, as gzip-compressed assets. We decompressed those assets in every published build of the jaeger-dev package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, on both x86_64 and aarch64: 21 builds, 2.19.0-r1 through 2.23.0-r4, 42 packages, each checked against its index checksum. Every build of one Jaeger version embeds the same UI bundle. The zod version object in the bundle is 4.4.2 in 2.19.0-r1 to 2.20.0-r5, 4.5.4 in 2.21.0-r0 and 2.21.0-r1, 4.6.4 in 2.22.0-r0 to 2.22.0-r3, and 4.6.6 from 2.23.0-r0. So 2.23.0-r0 is the first build with the fixed zod, and every earlier build has a vulnerable version.
